     Background                                                                              背景
     The Company is prohibited from directly owning any equity interest in Paqu              本公司不得直接擁有葩趣互娛的任何股權。因
     Huyu. Therefore, in order for our Group to effectively control and enjoy the            此，為使本集團有效控制及享有葩趣互娛全部

ESG Governance Structure                                                       ESG管治架構
The Company has established a three-level ESG governance structure             本公司建立了由董事會領導，ESG管理團隊
led by the Board, supervised by the ESG management team and jointly            以及 E S G 協同團隊共同參與的三層管治架
participated by the ESG collaboration team. As the highest responsible         構。其中，董事會作為最高責任與決策機
and decision-making body for ESG works, the Board is responsible for           構，負責制定公司整體 E S G 戰略及管理方
setting the Company’s overall ESG strategies and management policy,            針，監督ESG目標實施，定期審閱ESG報告
overseeing the implementation of ESG goals, regularly reviewing ESG            及相關事宜，指導和監督管理層開展具體
reports and related issues, and guiding and supervising the management         工作；ESG管理團隊負責協助董事會統籌戰
to carry out specific work. The ESG management team is responsible for         略及目標的實施，監督管理日常工作，定
assisting the Board in coordinating the implementation of ESG strategies       期向董事會匯報ESG工作進展；ESG協同團
and goals, supervising the management of daily work and regularly              隊由各職能部門組成，負責配合ESG管理團
reporting the progress of ESG work to the Board. Our ESG collaboration         隊統籌執行相關具體工作，貫徹落實各項
team comprised of various functional departments is responsible for            ESG事宜。
cooperating with our ESG management team to implement related
specific work and various ESG matters.

      of the ESG Report:                                                                                                        關於本報告
      描述或解釋在編備環境、社會及管治報告時如何應用匯報原則：
      Materiality: The ESG report should disclose: (i) the process to identify and the criteria for the selection of material
      ESG factors; (ii) if a stakeholder engagement is conducted, a description of significant stakeholders identified,
      and the process and results of the issuer’s stakeholder engagement.
      重要性：環境、社會及管治報告應披露：(i)識別重要環境、社會及管治因素的過程及選擇這些因素的準
      則；(ii)如發行人已進行持份者參與，已識別的重要持份者的描述及發行人持份者參與的過程及結果。

      Consistency: The issuer should disclose in the ESG report any changes to the methods or KPIs used, or any other

      有意義比較的相關因素。

                                    a sample basis, to their net realisable value through review
                                    of sales subsequent to the year end.
                                •   我們通過對年末以後的銷售情況進行審查，在抽樣的基
                                    礎上將存貨的賬面價值與可變現淨值進行了比較；


                                •   We assessed the reasonableness of methods and
                                    assumptions applied to the provisions by challenging
                                    management’s future sales projection, estimated future
                                    selling prices and selling expenses, with reference to
                                    industry trend, approved budget developed based on
                                    historical data and actual sales subsequent to the year end;
                                •   我們通過質疑管理層的未來銷售預測、未來銷售價格和
                                    銷售費用的估計（參考行業趨勢）、根據歷史資料制定的
                                    經審批預算及年結日後的實際銷售，評估撥備方法和假
                                    設的合理性；


                                •   We checked the mathematical accuracy of the calculation
                                    of the provision for inventories;
                                •   我們檢查了存貨減值準備計算的準確性；


                                •   We observed the physical condition of inventories during
                                    stocktake to identify if any inventories were damaged,
                                    or obsolete and inquired management if appropriate
                                    inventories provision has been made.
                                •   我們在存貨盤點期間查看了存貨的物理狀況，以確定存
                                    貨是否出現損壞或報廢，並詢問管理層是否已作出適當
                                    的存貨減值準備。


                                We found the assumptions adopted and judgment applied by
                                management in the determination of impairment provision for
                                inventories were supported by the evidence we gathered.
                                我們認為，管理層在確定存貨減值準備時採用的假設和運用
                                的判斷均有據可依。

      39 SUMMARY OF OTHER ACCOUNTING POLICIES                                          39 其他會計政策概要
         This note provides a list of other potentially material accounting policies     本附註載列編製該等綜合財務報表時所採
         adopted in the preparation of these consolidated financial statements.          用的其他可能重要的會計政策。除非另有
         These policies have been consistently applied to all the years presented,       說明，該等政策始終適用於呈列的全部年
         unless otherwise stated.                                                        份。


      (a) Property, plant and equipment                                                (a) 物業、廠房及設備
         Property, plant and equipment, other than construction in progress, are         物業、廠房及設備（在建工程除外）乃按歷
         stated at historical cost less accumulated depreciation and impairment.         史成本減累計折舊及減值列賬。歷史成本
         Historical cost includes expenditures that are directly attributable to the     包括收購項目的直接應佔支出。
         acquisition of the items.


         Subsequent costs are included in the asset’s carrying amount or                 後續成本僅在項目的相關未來經濟利益很
         recognised as a separate asset, as appropriate, only when it is probable        可能流入本集團，且項目的成本能可靠計
         that future economic benefits associated with the item will flow to the         量之情況下，方計入有關資產之賬面值或
         Group and the cost of the item can be measured reliably. The carrying           確認為獨立資產（如適用）。替換零件的賬
         amount of the replaced part is derecognised. All other repairs and              面值不予確認。所有其他維修及保養費在

         over the fair value of the net identifiable assets acquired is recorded          超過所收購可識別資產淨值的公平值部分

         directly in profit or loss as a gain on bargain purchase.                        直接於損益中確認為議價購買收益。


         Where settlement of any part of cash consideration is deferred, the              如現金代價任何部分的結算被延期，則未
         amounts payable in the future are discounted to their present value              來應付金額將按交換日的現值貼現。所用
         as at the date of exchange. The discount rate used is the entity’s               貼現率為實體的增量借款利率，即可資比
         incremental borrowing rate, being the rate at which a similar borrowing          較條款及條件下獨立融資人可獲得類似借
         could be obtained from an independent financier under comparable                 貸的利率。或然代價分類為權益或金融負
         terms and conditions. Contingent consideration is classified either as           債。分類為金融負債的金額隨後按公平值
         equity or a financial liability. Amounts classified as a financial liability     重新計量，公平值變動計入損益。
         are subsequently remeasured to fair value with changes in fair value
         recognised in profit or loss.
